| colspan="10" align="left" style="width:50px"| '''Notes:'''{{refbegin}}{{note|reward|1}} As the winner of the first Reward Challenge, Nicolas earned the Sacred Fire Talisman.<br />{{note|talisman|2}} The Sacred Fire Talisman was played for its holder, however, no votes were cast against them.<br />{{note|talisman2|3}} The Sacred Fire Talisman was played for another player however, no votes were cast against them.<br />{{note|captain|4}} As the winner of the fourth Reward Challenge, Gilles was able to choose another castaway tasked of forming the two new tribes. He chose Rudy and was then able to choose which of the two tribes he would join.<br />{{note|suddendeath|5}} The castaway who finished last in the fourth Reward Challenge would be eliminated from the game. Élodie came in last and was eliminated.<br />{{note|talisman3|6}} The Sacred Fire Talisman was played for another player, negating all votes against its user.<br />{{note|benjamin|7}} Benjamin elected to quit the game due to an injury.<br />{{note|martin|8}} Martin was evacuated from the game due to an injury.<br />{{note|gilles|9}} Gilles earned back the Sacred Fire Talisman after winning a special Individual Reward Challenge.<br />{{note|amb|10}} At the ambassadors meeting, Grâce and Quentin did not agree on a castaway to eliminate, therefore both of them drew rocks. Quentin lost the draw and was eliminated from the game.<br />{{note|grace|11}} Grâce elected to quit the game due to home sickness.<br />{{note|tieddestinies|12}} Clémence was Esteban's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when Esteban was voted out.<br />{{note|talismanimmunity|13}} Laura won a special challenge and earned the Sacred Fire Talisman. She earned immunity for herself as well as someone else. She chose Quentin and thus cancelled one vote against him at the following Impromptu Tribal Council.<br />{{note|necklace|14}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />{{note|final4|15}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Julie came in last and was eliminated.{{refend}}
